title: Stockfilm — Authentic Vintage Footage
description: Search and license 217,000+ authentic vintage 8mm home movie clips (1930s-1980s).
summary: Search and license 217,000+ authentic vintage 8mm home movie clips (1930s-1980s).
offersHint: Search and license 217,000+ authentic vintage 8mm home movie clips (1930s-1980s). · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.stockfilm.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: build_rough_cut
toolsPreview.description: Auto-assemble a timed sequence of vintage clips into a video timeline based on a description. Returns an ordered list of clips with durations. Great for creating edit lists or storyboards.

toolsPreview.name: check_clip_rights
toolsPreview.description: Verify a clip is eligible for a given intended use (commercial, editorial, broadcast, etc.) before licensing.

toolsPreview.name: find_similar_footage
toolsPreview.description: Find visually similar vintage clips by providing a clip ID. Returns clips with similar visual content from the Stockfilm archive.

toolsPreview.name: get_clip_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for a specific Stockfilm clip including description, year shot, location, price, resolution, thumbnail URL, and preview URL.

toolsPreview.name: license_clip
toolsPreview.description: License a vintage clip from Stockfilm. Costs $10 USD in USDC (Solana or Base). Returns the x402 endpoint URL for payment. License is royalty-free, worldwide, perpetual. To complete payment, use an x402-compatible agent framework or wallet.

toolsPreview.name: search_vintage_footage
toolsPreview.description: Search Stockfilm's archive of 217,000+ authentic vintage home movie clips from the 1930s-1980s. Returns clips with metadata, pricing, thumbnails, and licensing info. All footage is real 8mm/Super 8 film — no AI-generated content.
